nodes.name: additional-clause-section.component.ts

nodes.summary: Shared layout wrapper for novelty creation pages, rendering a breadcrumb trail and contract info card around page content.

nodes.summary: Wraps novelty page content with breadcrumb and contract-info-card inputs.
